v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Miserére * mei, Deus, secúndum magnam misericórdiam tuam. ‡
text.en: Have mercy on me, * O God, according to thy great mercy. ‡

text.la: Deduc me * in iustítia tua, Dómine.
text.en: Conduct me, * O Lord, in thy justice.

text.la: Dóminus dabit virtútem * et benedícet pópulo suo in pace.
text.en: God will give * power and strength to his people.

text.la: Convérsus est furor tuus, * Dómine, et consolátus es me.
text.en: Thy wrath is turned away * and thou hast comforted me.

text.la: Laudáte * Dóminum quóniam confirmáta est super nos misericórdia eius.
text.en: Praise * the Lord, for his mercy is confirmed upon us.

text.la: Veníte, et ascendámus ad montem Dómini, et ad domum Dei Iacob, et docébit nos vias suas, et ambulábimus in sémitis eius: quia de Sion exíbit lex, et verbum Dómini de Ierúsalem.
text.en: Come and let us go up to the mountain of the Lord, and to the house of the God of Jacob, and he will teach us his ways, and we will walk in his paths: for the law shall come forth from Sion, and the word of the Lord from Jerusalem.

v.la: Vox clamántis in desérto: Paráte viam Dómini.
v.en: A voice of one crying in the wilderness: Prepare the way of the Lord.

text.la: Egrediétur * virga de radíce Iesse, et replébitur omnis terra glória Dómini: et vidébit omnis caro salutáre Dei.
text.en: There shall come forth a rod * out of the stem of Jesse, and the whole earth shall be filled with the glory of the Lord, and all flesh shall see the salvation of God.

text.la: Aurem tuam, quǽsumus, Dómine, précibus nostris accómmoda: et mentis nostræ ténebras, grátia tuæ visitatiónis illústra:
text.en: O Lord, we beseech thee, mercifully incline thine ears unto our prayers, and lighten the darkness of our minds by the grace of thy heavenly visitation.
